fusions.name: Barbed Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a spore that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Reckoning
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 25% health for 16 damage, using up every affliction on it and adding 0.7 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Coiled Venom
fusions.desc: Increases your poison damage by 30% for 12 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Venom Tolerance
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 10% poison resistance and regenerate 0.8 health a second.
